about: Feeds for the RSS validator and the game-day headline digest (automation/rss/rss_digest.mjs). The digest stores title, source, link and timestamp only. Readers always link out to the source.

blocklist.note: Never ingest, show or link to these publishers. Matched against title, link host and link path.

outside.label: ESPN college football headlines that name an SEC team
titleMustMatch: Texas(?! Tech| State| Christian| A&M| El Paso)

outside.label: FloridaGators.com news
outside.note: floridagators.com sits behind bot protection (Incapsula). From some networks it returns an empty or blocked response. The digest then reports ok:false for this feed and shows nothing for it; it never fabricates items and does not try to bypass the protection.
